title: Five Ways a Test Can Lie to You

zones.label: Different teachers
zones.summary: How it misleads: One teacher's enthusiasm lifts one group. The defense: One teacher for both groups.
facts: How it misleads: One teacher's enthusiasm lifts one group.
The defense: One teacher for both groups.
Ask: what else is different besides the version?

zones.label: Different times of day
zones.summary: How it misleads: Students are more alert at one time. The defense: Both groups at the same time.
facts: How it misleads: Students are more alert at one time.
The defense: Both groups at the same time.
Ask: what else is different besides the version?

zones.label: Extra help
zones.summary: How it misleads: One group gets a review or hints. The defense: The same script and help for both.
facts: How it misleads: One group gets a review or hints.
The defense: The same script and help for both.

zones.label: Different tests
zones.summary: How it misleads: The versions are measured in different ways. The defense: The same test and key for both.

The defense: The same test and key for both.

zones.label: Student choice
zones.summary: How it misleads: Motivated students choose one version. The defense: Random assignment.
